answer.reason: The supplied material contains only a citation to the BLS QCEW API (no actual data rows), so this must be resolved with prior knowledge of Vermont's covered-employment levels. Vermont's private NAICS 54 (Professional, scientific, and technical services) has consistently run in the mid-15,000 to ~16,000 range in recent QCEW data: Vermont's total private covered employment is roughly 250,000-255,000, and its professional and business services supersector (~25,000-27,000 in CES) minus management of companies (~3,500) and administrative/support/waste services (~7,500) implies roughly 15,000-16,500 jobs for NAICS 54. A December 2024 level of 15,952 fits this trajectory well, whereas 17,683 would represent an implausible ~13% jump over the sector's 2023 average and is more consistent with figures for other Vermont industries (e.g., construction). The supplied draft answer of B therefore appears to reflect a mismatched figure, and the private-sector December 2024 level is 15,952 covered jobs.
